svg.title: freq's array of words filling up as the first lines of the book are read: when it is full it moves to a block twice as big
svg.text: the words array of bin/freq data/book.txt: one push for each different word

g.title: "the": the array is empty and has no block yet, so the push first takes one of 8 slots.
"conan" is the 8th different word: the block of 8 is full.
"doyle", the 9th different word, finds the block full: a new block of 16, the 8 words copied across, the old one freed.
"ii" is the 16th different word: the block of 16 is full.
"red", the 17th different word, finds the block full: a new block of 32, the 16 words copied across, the old one freed.
The whole book: 7818 different words of 105885, in a block of 8192. 11 grows copied 8184 words in all: fewer copies than words.
g.text: each block in turn, to scale: every grow copies what the last block held
